key_insight: SAM works best when its perturbation geometry matches the parameter structure, and a layerwise spectral inner perturbation combined with Muon gives the strongest robustness/generalization in this study.
engineering_relevance: For vision model training, choosing matrix-aware optimization geometry can materially improve validation accuracy, especially for hidden-layer weights in Transformers and CNNs.
method: Replace the usual SAM inner step with a layerwise spectral-norm perturbation for matrix-valued hidden-layer parameters.
Use either AdamW/SGDW or Muon for the outer update, and compare matrix-aware versus standard geometry choices.
Evaluate the spectral-inner + Muon pairing on ImageNet-1K for ViT-Small/16 and ResNet-50.
evidence_signal: On ImageNet-1K, the spectral inner step plus Muon outer step achieved the best validation accuracy on both ViT-Small/16 and ResNet-50 among the methods tested.
watch_item: The approach is geometry- and architecture-sensitive, so gains may depend on careful implementation of the spectral perturbation and Muon update for matrix-shaped layers.
paper_title: Sharpness-Aware Minimization and Muon: Robustness under the Spectral Norm
